ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God stabilized the mountains?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of 'istiqrar' (stability) as a divine mercy, ensuring the Earth remains a habitable realm for humanity. Scholars often link this anchoring to the prevention of catastrophic tectonic shifts, reflecting God's precise engineering in creation. It serves as a sign of divine power, reminding believers of the order and permanence established in the natural world.
